guide.description: A live, audio-reactive magic circle with eight evolving patterns, six palettes and three synthesized sound textures. Use K4E4 to perform while the canvas stays clear.

controls.action: Open the shared Menu, including Guide and audio routing.
Turn synthesized sound on or off.
Switch between Visual and Sound encoder layers. The monitor labels show the active layer.
Turn the audio-reactive input on or off; retry input after an error.
Next pattern: Orbit, Sigil, Lattice, Vortex, Eclipse, Bloom, Nova or Prism.
Next palette: Astral, Ember, Verdant, Ritual, Solar or Glacier.
Release an energy pulse. With SFX on, this also triggers an impact sound.

sections.title: Audio and saved settings
sections.text: Parameter values are saved automatically. Reopening starts on the Visual layer with SFX off; device audio input starts on. Choose input/output ports and their levels in Menu. Preview input is silent; enable Listen to preview before testing synthesized sound on the computer. Input-driven visual pulses do not retrigger impact sounds.
